title: 第43章 首遇恶鬼

第43章 首遇恶鬼-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜先去看了一下小丫头，发现她已经回吊坠里休息了，这才回到自己房间，阴魂出窍，迅速赶往任务地点。

等他从临时开辟的阴阳通道出来，发现这里已经有了四个鬼差了。

其中三个，看周身散发的气息，比起吴姜要浑厚的多，一看就不是普通鬼差。

吴姜也不托大，连忙上前一步，对着四人拱手见礼。

四人也十分客气，纷纷点头回应。

经过一番简单的介绍，吴姜才得知，那三位气息强大的，都是从地府上来的一等鬼差。而最后一个，看起来约莫五六十岁的年纪，周身的阴气和吴姜不相上下，却是和吴姜一样，是阳间兼职的鬼差。

此刻，这位阳间的鬼差大叔，看到吴姜的模样，再感受到他周身的阴气和实力，眼珠子差点瞪了出来，“小伙子，你……你也是二等鬼差？”

吴姜愣了一下，点了点头，笑着说道：“是啊，大叔，我刚成为阴差没多久，侥幸晋升为二等鬼差。”

“侥幸？”大叔的声音都大了几分，甚至带着一丝委屈，“老家伙我辛辛苦苦修炼了三十多年，才达到这般地步，你你你......”

大叔自己都说不下去了，越说越觉得自己是个废柴了。

吴姜只好回以一个腼腆的笑容，他能怎么说？总不能逢人就到处嚷嚷，自家的老祖宗是城隍爷，自己起步不仅有着高级修炼功法，还有外挂吧？

这时，为首的一名一等鬼差忽然开口了，“好了，别闲聊了，人到齐了，我们尽快行动吧，大家小心行事，那厉鬼杀害过鬼差，实力不容小觑，切勿轻敌。”

众人纷纷点头，收敛心神，不再多言。

这是一片山林，按照任务信息提示，此刻那个厉鬼，就是逃向了这片山林。

为首的那名鬼差，掏出一个类似罗盘的法器，示意众人跟在他的身后，一起往山上飞去。

几人分工明确，三名一等鬼差在前开路，吴姜和大叔鬼差在后接应，小心翼翼地朝着山林深处走去，仔细搜寻着厉鬼的踪迹。

山林里阴气越来越浓，凶煞之气也越来越重，周围静得可怕，只能听到风吹树叶的沙沙声，还有偶尔传来的几声诡异的鸟鸣，令人不寒而栗。

Chapter 43: Encountering an Evil Ghost for the First Time - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out I am the Nth generation of gods"

Wu Jiang first checked on the little girl and found that she had gone back to rest in the pendant. Then he returned to his room, his ghost left his body, and quickly rushed to the mission location.

When he came out of the temporarily opened Yin and Yang channel, he found that there were already four ghosts here.

The auras emanating from three of them are much richer than Wu Jiang's, and they are no ordinary ghosts at first glance.

Wu Jiang did not show off, and quickly stepped forward and bowed his hands to the four of them.

The four of them were also very polite and nodded in response.

After a brief introduction, Wu Jiang learned that the three powerful auras were all first-class ghost servants from the underworld.The last one, who looks to be about fifty or sixty years old, has the same yin energy as Wu Jiang, but like Wu Jiang, he is a part-time ghost job in the world of the world.

At this moment, when the uncle from the ghost world saw Wu Jiang's appearance and felt the yin energy and strength around him, his eyes almost popped out, "Young man, you... are you also a second-class ghost servant?"

Wu Jiang was stunned for a moment, nodded, and said with a smile: "Yes, uncle, not long after I became a ghost sergeant, I was lucky enough to be promoted to a second-class ghost sergeant."

"A fluke?" The uncle's voice was a little louder, even with a hint of grievance, "Old guy, I have worked hard for more than thirty years to reach this point, you, you, you..."

The uncle himself couldn't speak anymore. The more he spoke, the more he felt like a loser.

Wu Jiang could only respond with a shy smile. What could he say?You can't just yell around when you meet people. Your ancestor is the City God. When you start, you not only have advanced cultivation techniques, but also cheats, right?

At this time, the leader of the first-class ghost officer suddenly spoke, "Okay, stop chatting, everyone is here, let's act as soon as possible, everyone be careful, that fierce ghost has killed ghost officers, his strength should not be underestimated, don't underestimate the enemy."

Everyone nodded, calmed down and said no more.

This is a mountain forest. According to the mission information, the evil ghost is fleeing to this mountain forest at this moment.

The leading ghost officer took out a compass-like magic weapon and motioned for everyone to follow him and fly up the mountain together.

Several people had a clear division of labor. Three first-class ghosts were leading the way. Wu Jiang and the uncle ghosts were following behind. They walked cautiously towards the depths of the mountain forest, carefully searching for traces of the ghosts.

The gloomy air in the mountain forest is getting thicker and the ominous air is getting heavier and heavier. The surroundings are eerily quiet. The only sounds that can be heard are the rustling of leaves in the wind and the occasional strange chirping of birds, which makes people shudder.
